hardcodings.description: The demo is intentionally scoped to SkillGen.pdf.
hardcodings.reason: The user explicitly asked for a preliminary demo that only needs to work for this paper.
hardcodings.impact: The claim selector prioritizes SkillGen's paired-intervention/Table 1 claim shape.

hardcodings.description: The demo selects the Table 1 average-gains claim as the primary benchmark claim.
hardcodings.reason: The existing Phase 0 SkillGen note and the paper text identify it as the strongest Phase 0 target.
hardcodings.impact: Other SkillGen claims are not selected for the preliminary run, though they remain in the parsed paper text.

hardcodings.description: The demo blocks before official-code execution when hosted APIs, paid token use, external benchmark assets, or missing human approval are detected.
hardcodings.reason: Phase 0 rules require a human-visible command gate before risky or costly third-party execution.
hardcodings.impact: The demo produces a blocked validation package instead of running official benchmarks.

hardcodings.description: The automation uses `https://github.com/yccm/SkillGen` as the official SkillGen code source.
hardcodings.reason: The paper-specific POC targets SkillGen and needs a deterministic official-code intake source.
hardcodings.impact: A different paper or fork requires a different code-intake contract.

hardcodings.description: The first executable target is AIME with train_n=8, eval_n=4, and seed=42.
hardcodings.reason: The user requested the cheapest validation target for the preliminary Phase 0 POC.
hardcodings.impact: The smoke verdict does not reproduce the full SkillGen Table 1 claim.

hardcodings.description: The smoke command plan uses OpenRouter model names openai/gpt-5.4-nano and openai/gpt-5.4-mini.
hardcodings.reason: The existing smoke run used the cheapest available validation setup that still exercises official code.
hardcodings.impact: Changing provider routing or model availability may change cost, behavior, or reproducibility.

hardcodings.description: The result parser expects SkillGen eval_results.json, token usage JSON, and verification_summary.json shapes.
hardcodings.reason: The POC only needs to automate this paper's official-code output format.
hardcodings.impact: Other papers or future SkillGen output schemas need a different parser contract.

hardcodings.description: The command plan uses eval_skill.py --skill-repo/--dataset flags when the README example appears mismatched.
hardcodings.reason: The executable script parser is treated as the source of truth for the current official checkout.
hardcodings.impact: This is a recorded deviation from README text and must remain visible for human review.

hardcodings.description: The all-claims automation uses a SkillGen-specific catalog of major empirical and executable claims.
hardcodings.reason: The POC is scoped to SkillGen.pdf and the paper's claims require paper-specific grouping before verification.
hardcodings.impact: The catalog is not a general claim extractor for arbitrary papers.

hardcodings.description: The all-claims matrix hardcodes the Table 1 row ids and eight paper model display names.
hardcodings.reason: These are needed to detect which full-paper claims can be matched to official-code data and model routes.
hardcodings.impact: Exact provider route IDs still need review before full unattended Table 1 execution.
